st_flaneurs.name: Ruisseau des Ancres
st_flaneurs.alt: A winding country road between hedges beside a little brook, with a red-roofed farmhouse, a hay chute and a kite in the sky, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe drops a little iron anchor from his rowing boat into the brook; slides down the hay chute legs in the air; trots knees-high beside a pony; hands a doctor's note to a yawning sheep in a gold beret; sets two alarm clocks to the same time on a fence; and pushes the nozzle back into an old fuel pump. The road at the far left leads back to the crossroads. The garden gate in the hedge, the leafy tunnel and the stone footbridge lead on.

doors.hint: Through the wooden garden gate in the hedge

doors.label: Pré des Parachutistes
doors.hint: Through the leafy tunnel in the hedge

cyclistes.name: Allée des Cyclistes
cyclistes.alt: The flowery front garden of the red-roofed farmhouse beside the country road, with a cattle pen, a gravel path and a pie cooling on the window sill: Monsieur Verbe looks sadly at his cool box melted into a puddle; strolls past the flowers in a long flannel scarf; raises his bidding paddle at the farm auction in a green beret; follows his nose to the steaming pie; and pedals a tiny tricycle with his knees up to his ears. The garden gate on the left leads back to the road; the open farm gate on the right leads on to the meadow.

doors.label: Ruisseau des Ancres
doors.hint: Back through the wooden garden gate

doors.label: Pré des Parachutistes
doors.hint: Through the open farm gate to the meadow

parachutistes.name: Pré des Parachutistes
parachutistes.alt: A breezy meadow beside the country road, with kites in the sky, a ditch with a little wooden drawbridge, a red vending machine by a bench, a potted palm and an old lamp post: Monsieur Verbe leads a racehorse carrying sandbags; puts a coin in the vending machine; pulls the lever to lower the drawbridge; walks off past the palm tree with a suitcase and a hand mirror; and floats down under a striped parachute towards the lamp post. The farm gate on the left leads back; the stone footbridge on the right leads on.

convois.name: Hangar des Convois
convois.alt: A farm lane beside the brook with a wooden parcel-sorting shed and its conveyor belt, blossom trees and swallows on the telegraph wires: Monsieur Verbe crosses his arms and frowns at his bubble bath; waves goodbye to the swallows flying south; rides the conveyor belt with the parcels; trots down the lane on the postal pony with a parcel; and drives a little yellow tow truck carrying a broken bicycle. The stone footbridge on the left leads back to the road.
